# Variable `PACKAGE_PREPROCESS_FUNCS`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies a list of functions run to pre-process the PKGD directory prior to splitting the files out to individual packages.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-PACKAGE_PREPROCESS_FUNCS)
